trigger.novelty_evidence: The retained V1 ArXiv result was complete only through its 2026-08-29 execution. Two later calendar days can contain newly submitted primary papers, while venue polling remains unjustified.

question: Has a new primary paper submitted after the retained 2026-08-29 literature checkpoint exposed a materially distinct direction-independent Polymarket or Binance mechanism that satisfies an existing literal retry trigger or deserves a new fail-closed registry family?

endpoint_classification.operation: download one bounded ArXiv Atom metadata result
endpoint_classification.source_contract: The ArXiv export API supplies public scholarly metadata. This is not a venue, account, trading, or state-changing endpoint.

retained_sources.use: last bounded result and exact pre-existing paper population

decision.source_gate_only: The response must be a bounded ArXiv Atom feed with at least one entry.
decision.offline_delta_gate: Parse only papers with published_utc strictly later than 2026-08-29T22:37:17.664866Z, exact-title and identifier alias-check each survivor before any source or venue request, and reject directional prediction, security exploitation, and already-registered mechanisms.
decision.terminal_if_no_novel_survivor: Do not poll venue data. Reopen only after a later primary-paper or material official-mechanism change.

retry_policy: This exact bounded query is one-use. Preserve any HTTP error, Atom-gate failure, or empty post-cutoff delta. Do not paginate, alter keywords, retry an alias, download a paper, or call venue data after observing the response unless a preregistered novel survivor literally justifies it.
